Start date: 1069-05-20  
Add 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 337 days.  

1069 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1069-05-20 to end of year:  
May: 31 - 20 = 11 days  
Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total = 11 + 30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 225 days remaining in 1069.  

337 - 225 = 112 days into 1070.  
1070 is not a leap year (1070 ÷ 4 = 267.5).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 → 31+28+31 = 90 days.  
112 - 90 = 22 days into April.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1070-04-22
